lineage.description: Road network data extracted from OpenStreetMap using highway tag filtering, compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) for the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Features include geometry (lines and polygons) with attributes for road classification, surface type, width, lanes, and other infrastructure characteristics relevant to exposure assessment.
